title: What they said at the time

clips.q: Sharper Image has not demonstrated a reasonable probability that any of the challenged statements were false.
They just haven’t really brought anything into the stores that people overwhelmingly feel like they really need to own.
clips.who: **Joan Storms**, Wedbush Morgan Securities, in the Los Angeles Times, Sep 27, 2006[^3]

clips.q: Sharper Image did not fit into our go-forward strategy.
clips.who: **John Haugh**, chief executive of Iconix, Dec 30, 2016[^14]
